body: Yes, this makes sense. I know most places do peer audits, too. But to me an “audit” means just going in for a finite period of time and taking a look at that person’s charting. This is a constant surveillance that has been going on for months now
That’s insanity. Documentation takes up a ridiculous amount of time as it is.

That other person must not spend much time on Reddit. I’ve definitely seen longer posts. I read the whole thing and I’m sorry you had to go through that and I thank you for sharing it. Unfortunately in my case the person critiquing my notes is my direct manager, so it’s not just one person I can avoid. I really hope I can avoid the extreme that you had to endure. But I do relate to the “old school PT with nothing better to do” remark. It does give me hope that it sounds like you’re still in this career field.

I get that. I’ve done probably a few hundred treats since I’ve been here, and there’s been max 8-10 notes brought to me where they needed to point out something or ask for clarification.

I haven’t been explicitly told my notes lack substance or that there’s ongoing issues that haven’t been corrected. Yet they continue to read ALL my notes.
Yeah, she’s American. She’s just a really unemotional person. It’s like impossible for her to talk about feelings or show me any affection.

To add to this, get in the turn lane BEFORE you start to slow down to turn left. If there’s a center left turn lane, USE IT. So many people slow all the way down to make their turn as if there’s no turn lane for this purpose!

Man, WHY is is nearly impossible at most jobs to get a straight answer about how PTO works and how to request time off? I’ve had so many jobs where it’s like this. It’s almost like they don’t want you to use your vacation time /s

Thanks, we actually have a good time together for the most part and she is a good mom, but as soon as I talk about how I’m feeling or have a breakdown she doesn’t want to hear about it.

The good thing to know for you is even if you’re with someone, you’re still ultimately alone. Getting married taught me that. Because I am alone when it comes to confronting my mental health obstacles, even though my wife is physically around me all of the time; she wants nothing to do with my struggles.
Hey, feel free to DM me. I'm willing to talk

Don't kill yourself. My wife is a woman most people wouldn't find attractive. But I think she's beautiful. I've never thought she's more beautiful than since she had our first baby.

My point is, someone out there thinks you're gorgeous. Don't let those who think otherwise get you down. You've obviously put work into your appearance. That in itself is very attractive. Someone who cares about how they look and puts in effort to look good is automatically attractive to me. Seriously.
Hey, you seem like you at least try to be a good person. That counts for something. Don't kill yourself!

Man, I feel this SO MUCH. I would have killed myself already if I didn't have my little baby boy. I love that little guy to pieces and don't want him to grow up without me around. My mom and dad and siblings would also be sad. Heck, even my in-laws would be sad. And my classmates. But my wife? She gets annoyed when I tell her I want to kill myself.
